landmarks.name: Bangalore Palace
landmarks.hint: A royal palace modelled on Windsor Castle, built for the Wadiyar kings in 1887

landmarks.name: Cubbon Park
landmarks.hint: A landmark green lung of the city, spread over 300 acres in the heart of Bengaluru

landmarks.name: Lalbagh Botanical Garden
landmarks.hint: A 240-acre botanical garden with rare plants, a 3,000-million-year-old rock and a historic glasshouse

landmarks.name: Vidhana Soudha
landmarks.hint: The impressive granite seat of Karnataka's state legislature, built in neo-Dravidian style

landmarks.name: ISKCON Temple
landmarks.hint: One of the largest ISKCON temples in the world, dedicated to Radha Krishnachandra on Rajajinagar hill

landmarks.name: Ulsoor Lake
landmarks.hint: A large urban lake in east Bengaluru, popular for boating and morning walks

landmarks.name: Tipu Sultan's Summer Palace
landmarks.hint: An exquisite example of Indo-Islamic architecture built by Tipu Sultan in the old city

landmarks.name: HAL Aerospace Museum
landmarks.hint: India's first aerospace museum, showcasing aircraft and aero-engines made by Hindustan Aeronautics

landmarks.name: Bannerghatta National Park
landmarks.hint: A national park on the southern outskirts of Bengaluru, home to tigers, lions, and elephants

landmarks.name: Electronic City
landmarks.hint: India's first purpose-built IT township, housing major tech companies in south Bengaluru
